Follow-up to v0.1.76, from the first two joins on it.

## Server

### Fixed
- The saved player record's inventory id is aligned with the id the inventory is actually saved and stamped under. With v0.1.76 both loads returned the player's own record and the server pawn held the right items, but the game's own load then re-keyed the pawn to the inventory id stored in the record, which pointed at nothing. The client came up bound to an empty inventory with the items locked in the hotbar, while position and stats persisted. The record is aligned at boot for every record under a synthetic id, and again at each join before the load.

### Changed
- The boot-time layout dump lists every saved player record: id, inventory id and last seen name.
